It's time to tell some tales! 

Episode 13: Tales, Tales, Tales, brought to you by Hammpions Broadcast International, premieres this Thursday at 11 PM Eastern/Midnight Friday BRT. 

Available only on HBI and selected global distribution partners.

Good News! Our 12th dispatch from the front lines of automotive bad decisions is being cast upon the Internet Dump Truck tonight at 11P Eastern. 

Dial into your intertubes and give it a listen.

Coming up on this week's The International Race of Hammpions... This week's broadcast is brought to you by Antonio's Italian Car Specialists in Lutts, TN. 

Antonio's service will have you saying "Fix it again, Tony!"
